caption.text:
It started with threats in the comments & ending with him deleting his account….

Heads up to all expats in Costa Rica- had someone posing as an attorney for the Immigration Department tell me to delete all of my posts about CR & not make any more. 

He started out saying he was a lawyer for the government who “would like to greet me at an immigration checkpoint” & then we took it to the DM’s- read the whole conversation below. 

I sent everything to me lawyer who said I should verify his identity & that all CR officials are required to identify themselves. At this point he told me to “be very careful,” quit responding & then deleted his account. His handle was scpsycr, so if you see him creeping on your page, disregard. 

All that being said, DOWN WITH GENTRIFICATION!!! If you wanna come to CR, please respect the culture & help the people ❤️ Pura Vida 🇨🇷 #joefelz #costarica #scammer #expatlife #creatorlife

caption.text:
At EVERY turn over the past 4 years we have been slapped in the face with some kind of nonsense and EVERY time we pull our britches up and get to work. 

This trip to the states was supposed to be 8 days long. We got hit from every side, Joes dad passing, unnamed family issues, came back to houses that contractors left fiftyleven issues on that we gotta fix, etc. etc. etc. 

But honestly…this is life. 

Everybody wants to talk about the wins. Nobody talks about the weeks where you’re exhausted, grieving, overwhelmed, broke down mentally and still have to wake up and handle the shït sammich in front of you. 

That’s where it matters. That’s the real test. 

Not whether life hits you - ‘cause it’s gonna…
Whether you get back up after it does and keep moving. 

Victim is not an option. Survivor is. 

What’s knockin your dïk in the dirt right now?💪🏻🛠️🛟#mindset #joeandalx #lifebelifin #CanDo #felzdontfold

This is the Wall of Fame in Joe’s Tree Retreat, an open space for people to write notes about their experience tucked away in the Smokey Mountains. After just 2 years it is absolutely covered with messages of love, happy family memories & life changing experiences. The last one is my favorite 🖖
